title: register-entry
description: A decision entry: one entry of the decision register as a record of its own (AR-1, DEC-718): its id, status, owner, date and its own span, the text its own hash is taken over. Decisions are headings in the register, not files (DEC-274); core-schema does not read the register, and the store's record of each entry is held to this schema by the ticket that builds it (W2-03), which also gives the span its form.

status.description: The entry's status word, as its `Status:` line gives it (ACCEPTED, for example).

owner.description: Who decided, as the entry's `Status:` line names it (the owner, or the role it was delegated to).

date.description: The date of the decision, as the entry's `Status:` line gives it.

span.description: The entry's own text in the register, from its heading to the next; its form is the store's (W2-03).
